what_happened.line: The Parks Commission met without its chair and passed only two votes: approving prior minutes and adjourning.
Members agreed to invite the DPW director to the next meeting and to send general questions to the chair beforehand.
A vote on the beach rental policy was deferred until the recreation director finalizes a draft.
On Marshall Park, the recreation director will compile members' ideas into one document to be cut to a short list before a survey and park walk-throughs.
The next meeting was proposed for April 28, subject to the chair's availability.

why_it_matters: Marshall Park's future, including a skatepark location, field use and whether the basketball court can be saved, is still at the idea-gathering stage, with a resident survey and park walk-throughs ahead.

Park maintenance has been put out to bid for a July 1 start, and the commission's maintenance policy waits on a meeting with the DPW director, so how town parks are kept up this summer is still being set.
watch_next: Town Meeting on May 1, where the commission hopes funds for a Marshall Park consultant will be supported.
The commission's next meeting, proposed for April 28, with the DPW director invited and the beach rental policy vote expected back on the agenda.
